source: Existing static/i18n.js I18n.language, initialized from agentcity-language localStorage; existing app normalization en-or-ru remains authoritative.
existing_transport: CoreWebView2.ExecuteScriptAsync, already used by host recovery; no new WebMessage, host object, backend command, endpoint or config setting.
new_internal_read_contract: Fixed DesktopLocale.SnapshotScript reads only {version:1,language:ru|en}, or null before I18n exists. No secret/storage reads in host.
scope: CityWindow UI thread. IsCurrentLocaleDocument requires retained CoreWebView2 reference, non-disposed window/view, non-closing state, successful matching top-level navigation, exact WirePolicy origin and current/completed documentEpoch. It is checked before/after read and by CopyFor. New-document SourceChanged and failed navigation explicitly invalidate accepted locale and in-flight sequence even at the same pending epoch. Fragment/history SourceChanged can retain readiness only for an already successful document.
availability: Unknown before the current document provides a valid response. Do not derive a language from private profile, OS culture or previous origin. Invalid/unavailable read preserves the last valid value for the same document only.
fallback: No host language is selected before a valid snapshot. NativeText uses the existing legacy RU copy when guarded CopyFor is unavailable; this is explicitly unlocalized presentation, not private-profile/OS inference. Invalid snapshot preserves a last valid language only within the same guarded document.
persistence_limit: Host creates a fresh temporary browser profile and a process-specific origin. Availability of language saved in another browser/profile or previous host launch is not established; do not claim cross-launch persistence.
integration_remaining: Native acceptance for actual WebView2 script visibility, saved RU/EN and live switching, menu/status accessible names and fit/focus, restart/close confirmations, recovery/revoke/backend loss, stale navigation and teardown. No GUI execution occurred.

Pre-document Program profile/mode-conflict dialogs remain legacy RU: no existing app locale is available in those processes. Cross-launch locale persistence is not established; no new data/settings contract was added.
refresh: Successful NavigationCompleted, menu DropDownOpening, before restart/close confirmation, and a separate 1-second UI-only timer skipped during busy auth/runtime actions. In-flight reads are shared; stale-document reads cannot commit, and new current-document reads are attempted after an older read drains. Reads use a 2-second deadline and never call the backend or bootstrap. UI timer skips an in-flight read; menu/confirmation reads share it. A read from an older epoch drains before a new current-document read. Pending confirmation disables native action items and rechecks disposal/busy/closing before presentation.
